title: QA Manual- Pharmacy Claims
description:
**Work Location - Initially Remote, Later hybrid for Coimbatore**

We are looking for a QA Engineer with strong experience in US Healthcare applications, preferably with exposure to Pharmacy, PBM, Prescription Claims, Drug Management, or Healthcare Claims processing.

Prior 340B experience is preferred but not mandatory.

The candidate should have strong healthcare domain fundamentals and should be capable of quickly understanding and testing 340B workflows.

Experience

- 4+ years of QA / Software Testing experience

- 2+ years of experience working on US Healthcare applications

- Experience in Pharmacy, PBM, Healthcare Claims, Prescription Claims, Medicaid/Medicare, or similar healthcare products preferred

Key Domain Skills

Candidates with experience in any of the following areas are preferred:

- Pharmacy Benefit Management (PBM)

- Pharmacy / Prescription Claims

- Healthcare Claims Processing

- Claim Adjudication

- Medicaid / Medicare

- Drug / NDC Management

- Patient Eligibility

- Provider / Pharmacy Management

- Claim Reversal / Reprocessing

- Financial Reconciliation

- Healthcare Billing

- Contract Pharmacy workflows

- Drug purchase, dispense, and replenishment workflows

Testing Skills

- Strong Functional and Regression Testing experience

- End-to-end healthcare workflow validation

- API Testing using Postman or similar tools

- Strong SQL and database validation

- Backend data validation

- Batch / file processing validation

- Data reconciliation testing

- Integration testing across multiple systems

- Ability to validate large-volume healthcare transaction data

- Good understanding of defect analysis and root-cause investigation

Technical Knowledge

Good understanding of:

- REST APIs

- JSON

- SQL

- Database queries

- Healthcare integrations

- EDI / batch files

- Data mapping and transformation

- Authentication and authorization

- HIPAA / PHI handling

Exposure to healthcare standards such as HL7, FHIR, X12, or NCPDP is an added advantage.

340B Knowledge – Preferred, Not Mandatory

Experience or understanding of any of the following will be an added advantage:

- 340B Drug Pricing Program

- Covered Entities

- Contract Pharmacies

- Third-Party Administrators (TPA)

- 340B Eligibility

- Claim qualification

- Accumulator processing

- Split Billing

- Drug replenishment

- Medicaid Carve-In / Carve-Out

- Duplicate Discount prevention

- Diversion prevention

- HRSA / OPAIS

- 340B audit and compliance workflows

Benefits:

* Flexible schedule
* Provident Fund
* Work from home

Application Question(s):

* What is your CTC & ECTC ?
* What is your notice period ?
* This job is initially remote, later hybrid for Coimbatore. Are you comfortable relocating to Coimbatore ?

Experience:

* QA Manual: 4 years (Required)
* Healthcare Pharmacy Claims: 2 years (Required)

Work Location: Hybrid remote in Coimbatore, Tamil Nadu

title: LEAD ADMINISTRATOR L1(CONTRACT)
description:
Job Title: LEAD ADMINISTRATOR L1(CONTRACT)

City: Bengaluru

State/Province: Karnataka

Posting Start Date: 10/12/26

Wipro Limited (NYSE: WIT, BSE: 507685, NSE: WIPRO) is a leading technology services and consulting company focused on building innovative solutions that address clients’ most complex digital transformation needs. Leveraging our holistic portfolio of capabilities in consulting, design, engineering, and operations, we help clients realize their boldest ambitions and build future-ready, sustainable businesses. With over 230,000 employees and business partners across 65 countries, we deliver on the promise of helping our customers, colleagues, and communities thrive in an ever-changing world. For additional information, visit us at www.wipro.com.

Role Purpose

The purpose of this role is to resolve high-priority incidents through advanced troubleshooting, ensure SLA compliance, analyse system performance trends, and create mitigation measures by collaborating with internal and external stakeholders.

**͏**
-----

Areas of responsibility

Triaging and resolution of tickets-Provide resolution to high priority incident (P2) tickets, performing advanced troubleshooting and root cause analysis to ensure timely closure.

SLA Monitoring-Ensure SLA compliance for assigned technology areas and ensure proactive escalation management.

Performance tuning and optimization-Analyse system performance data, coordinate findings on system behaviour, and support capacity planning initiatives to enhance overall system efficiency.

Perform system Improvements-Create mitigation measures to evaluate new tools or improvements by collaborating with technical teams.

Handling disaster recovery-Perform security assessments and recovery drills, and implement necessary controls to ensure compliance with established security standards.

Reporting and stakeholder engagement-Participate in weekly and monthly service review meetings, provide updates on performance and issues, and support stakeholder communication to ensure transparency and service alignment.

Team Management-Collaborate with team members to resolve open tickets and service requests.

Knowledge base and continuous learning Contribute to updating SOPs, knowledge articles and maintaining the knowledge repository for the purpose of future ticket resolution.

**͏**

Mark up - 200K/M

As a member of the C&CA team, Sr. IVR Developer will develop and support DTMF and Voice BOTs to meet the overall goal of the business and program. This role is part of a large transformational program team that will enable many lines of business in the enterprise. It is central for enabling meaningful and personalized customer experience in the assisted service channels (IVR) and will lead the organization in adopting increasingly advanced capabilities.

* This role covers **both Development and Support.**
* Build / Develop / Support DTMF and Conversational IVRs (Integrated Voice Response) BOTs and perform unit / component test aligned to business needs and in accordance with technology architecture standards
* In conjunction with the Solution Architect, assist the Application Owner, Development Manager and Technical Delivery Lead by providing effort estimates for new projects and initiatives
* Identify and address any issue that affects the integrity of the application (e.g. cross-capability/release issues)
* Collaborate and interact directly with design, business and technology partners. Covers technical planning, integration, systems analysis, design, development, unit and component systems testing and support-maintenance
* Create and maintain quality code, ensure defect free programming consistent with standards; provide code maintenance and support during testing cycles and post-production deployment and participate in reviewing peer coding
* Continuously enhance knowledge / expertise in own area and keep current with leading-edge technologies, emerging trends/developments and grow knowledge of the business, applications, infrastructure, analytical tools and techniques
* Performs complex to difficult technical tasks independently and resolves highly complex and multifaceted development related problems
* Ensure design leverages existing reusable components, traces back to business requirements, and that new modules are designed with reusability in mind
  

**Requirements**

* Undergraduate Degree or Technical Certificate (Graduate degree preferred)
* 4+ years of experience in DTMF IVR application development in **CVP** (Contact Center)
* Relevant technologies include but are not limited to:
  + **Cisco Call Studio / Cisco CVP VXML Server, CVP custom elements (Java), Call Studio GUI, Apache Tomcat, etc.**
* Java development with client backend integrations ( **HTTP REST APIs, oAuth2, XML Web Services,** MS SQL Server)
* **Knowledge of UCCE / ICM (Integration of CVP IVR Applications with UCCE Routing Scripts, DNIS ,Queuing to Skillgroup, CTI Variables, Finesse Agent Desktop)**
* Experience in Voice BOT development (Google Dialogflow, Microsoft etc) is nice to have
* Experience in Analysis of speech, speech repair and fine tuning of NLU is a plus
* Understanding of AWS, Google Cloud and Microsoft Azure is a plus.
* High comfort level in leading the build / support (7/24/365) of highly complex and/or comprehensive applications/systems
* Familiarity with tools like JIRA, **Cyara** and **Confluence**
* Strength in identifying **root causes and implementing targeted and controlled remediation plans**
* Strong verbal and written communication skills are essential
* Self-motivated team player with high energy and ability to work independently as well as within a team
* Hands-on experience with various SDLC including waterfall, specially agile
* Experience working within a large-scale Financial Enterprise environment
  

Mandatory Skills: Interactive Voice Response Development .  
Experience: 5-8 Years .  
Reinvent your world. We are building a modern Wipro. We are an end-to-end digital transformation partner with the boldest ambitions. To realize them, we need people inspired by reinvention. Of yourself, your career, and your skills. We want to see the constant evolution of our business and our industry. It has always been in our DNA - as the world around us changes, so do we. Join a business powered by purpose and a place that empowers you to design your own reinvention.

title: Lead Fashion Design
description:
Job Title: Lead \- Fashion Design

Location: Coimbatore

Employment Type: Full\-time (In person)

About the Role

We are a made\-to\-order bespoke clothing brand seeking a talented professional who can combine fashion design expertise with strong sales and client management skills. If you are passionate about fashion design, fabrics, silhouettes, and styling—and also enjoy interacting with customers and driving sales—this role is perfect for you.

Key Responsibilities

Client Engagement \& Sales

* Greet clients warmly and provide a premium, personalized experience.
* Understand customer needs thoroughly and recommend suitable fashion design options.
* Confidently present design ideas, fabric choices, and customization options.
* Convert walk\-ins and online leads into confirmed orders using strong sales skills.
* Follow up with potential clients regularly to drive conversions and meet monthly sales targets.
* Be sales\-oriented and proactive in achieving and exceeding sales goals.

Fashion Design Consultation \& Product Knowledge

* Offer expert fashion design consultations based on trends, body types, and client preferences.
* Stay updated on latest fashion design trends, silhouettes, cuts, and bespoke detailing.
* Suggest appropriate fabrics and design elements to enhance client satisfaction.
* Work closely with the production coordinator to ensure accurate design specifications and timely delivery.
* Contribute ideas for new collections, sampling, and overall fashion design improvements.

Store Growth \& Walk\-in Strategies

* Develop creative strategies to increase store walk\-ins and brand visibility.
* Collaborate with marketing to create campaigns that highlight new designs and fabric launches.
* Provide proactive ideas for events, display changes, and seasonal design promotions.

Presentation \& Professionalism

* Maintain excellent grooming standards that reflect the brand’s premium image.
* Ensure the store environment aligns with a luxury, made\-to\-order fashion design studio.
* Demonstrate proactive, solution\-oriented behaviour in everyday operations.

Requirements and Skills:

* Qualifications: Bachelors in Fashion Design / Fashion Technology or Equivalent
* Strong interest and knowledge in fashion design, styling, and fabrics.
* Experience in bespoke wear, fashion retail, or sales is a plus.
* Excellent communication and interpersonal skills.
* Ability to manage multiple clients and coordinate with production teams.
* Self\-driven, sales\-oriented, and passionate about achieving high performance.

Salary and Perks:

* Salary starts: from Rs. 25000 per month upto Rs. 30000 per month
* Salary Includes free Accommodation

Why Join Us?

* Work in a creative, design\-driven environment.
* Opportunity to apply and grow your fashion design and client styling skills.
* Growth potential with performance\-based incentives.
